title: Targeted Delegation Return
description: Return schema for targeted delegation. The sub-agent returns the result plus decisions made during execution.

delegation_type.description: Must match the delegation type from the prompt.

result.description: The actual output or answer. Structure varies by task.

decisions_made.description: Decisions made during execution with rationale.

unexpected_findings.description: Findings outside the task scope that may be relevant to the parent or peers.

scope_extensions.description: Areas the agent extended into beyond the original scope.

cross_scope_findings.description: Findings relevant to other agents or scopes.

gaps.description: Things the agent could not resolve.

carry_forward.description: Information the parent should carry to subsequent delegations.
